meta.description: Bona i-UMF yeresiphi ye-glaze, isilinganiso se-silica ne-alumina nebhalansi yama-flux. Mahhala, umthombo ovulekile: amaresiphi, okokwakha, amarekhodi okushisa.
meta.guides: Imihlahlandlela ngolimi olulula yababumbi abasha: yini i-glaze, indlela yokuyenza nokuyixuba ngokuphepha, ukuvikela umndeni wakho, nokushisa ku-kiln elula.
meta.glazingBasics: Yini eyakha i-glaze, i-kiln iyiguqula kanjani ibe yingilazi, nokuthi ama-cone, ama-frit, i-UMF nezinkinga ze-glaze kusho ukuthini. Umhlahlandlela wababumbi abasha.
meta.makingAGlaze: Indlela yokuthenga, ukugcina, ukukala nokuxuba i-glaze, ukuthola ukujiya kwayo kahle, ukuyihlola obumbeni lwakho nokugcina amarekhodi ukuze uphinde uyenze.
meta.safeMixing: Indlela yokugcina uthuli lwe-glaze lungangeni emaphashini akho nentuthu ye-kiln ingangeni ekhaya: imikhuba ephephile, ama-respirator, ukuhlanza, umoya nokokwakha okuyingozi.
meta.homeSafety: Okufanele ukwenze uma ingane noma isilwane sasekhaya sigwinya okokwakha kwe-glaze, nendlela yokugcina okokwakha, uthuli, i-kiln nezitsha ezenziwe ngesandla ziphephile emndenini wakho.
meta.firing: Indlela yokushisa ku-kiln kagesi: khetha, beka futhi ufunde ama-cone, ulandele izinhlelo ezishicilelwe zokushisa i-bisque ne-glaze, kanye neshadi lama-cone.
meta.learnWithJohnBritt: Umngane wesifundo se-glaze samahhala ku-inthanethi sikaJohn Britt: amavidiyo akhe iyunithi ngeyunithi, nemihlahlandlela ye-Glazecalc nezivivinyo zokuzama esibalini.
meta.advice: Amathiphu awusizo okuxuba, ukufaka i-glaze nokushisa, avela ku-Glazecalc, kanye nanoma yisiphi iseluleko sakho. Kumahhala kubabumbi.
meta.about: I-Glazecalc iyisibali samahhala nencwadi yekhemistri ye-glaze, enomthombo ovulekile. Bona ukuthi ibala kanjani i-UMF nokuthi yakhiwe kanjani.
meta.privacy: Indlela i-Glazecalc ephatha ngayo imininingwane yakho: azikho izikhangiso, ukuhlaziywa noma ukulandelelwa, futhi akukho okuthengiswayo. Yini egcinwayo, kungani, namalungelo akho.
meta.terms: Imigomo yokusebenzisa i-Glazecalc: kumahhala kuma-glaze akho nomsebenzi wakho, kunobulungiswa kuseva eyabiwe, futhi kunikezwa njengoba kunjalo.
meta.assistants: Sebenzisa i-Glazecalc ku-Claude, Copilot, Cursor noma Gemini nge-MCP: ikhemistri ye-glaze, ukuhlola imikhawulo, okungathatha indawo, imihlahlandlela namaresiphi akho.
meta.signup: Vula i-akhawunti yamahhala ye-Glazecalc ukuze ugcine amaresiphi akho e-glaze, okokwakha, amanothi namarekhodi okushisa. Azikho izikhangiso, imininingwane yakho ayithengiswa.
meta.cones: Ama-cone e-Orton ne-SK kusukela ku-022, namazinga awo okushisa ngo-°C no-°F, isivinini sokushisa ishadi ngalinye elenzelwe sona nomthombo wezibalo.
meta.materials: Okokwakha emtatsheni ojwayelekile we-Glazecalc, kusukela kuma-feldspar nobumba kuya kuma-frit nemithombo ye-boron, ngakunye nokuhlaziywa kwama-oxide, i-UMF nezingozi.
meta.materialInfo: Okokwakha {name}: ukuhlaziywa kwama-oxide, i-UMF, i-LOI (loss on ignition) nezingozi emtatsheni ojwayelekile we-Glazecalc.
meta.materialInfoLong: Okokwakha {name} emtatsheni ojwayelekile we-Glazecalc wokokwakha kwe-glaze: ukuhlaziywa kwama-oxide, isabelo sayo ku-UMF, i-LOI (loss on ignition) nezingozi.
meta.imageAlt: Uphawu lwe-Glazecalc nesihloko salo, ikhemistri ye-glaze yamahhala yababumbi, eduze kwesithombe samaqoqo ama-cone ashisiwe.

settingsExpiry.text: Awuyisebenzisanga i-Glazecalc kulesi siphequluli cishe unyaka. Izilungiselelo zakho lapha, njengetimu nolimi, zigcinwa uma nje usasisebenzisa. Ungazisula manje uma uthanda. Izilungiselelo ezilondolozwe ku-akhawunti yakho azithinteki.
